phase_name: Baseline capture, then extract the territory-contention concern

Replace extracted regions in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh with source + pointer comment
Verify green and byte-identical before committing

approaches_tried.approach: Convert every closed-over local (effective_group, session_id, new_cycle_count, CONTENDED_MANIFEST_DIR, PROJECT_ROOT) into an explicit function parameter, serializing effective_group as JSON, per the plan's literal instruction
approaches_tried.reason: Superseded by a safer alternative after direct experimentation. Verified with two minimal bash fixtures (a scalar `local` and a `local -A` associative array, each in a separate sourced file from the caller) that bash's `local` scoping is DYNAMIC (call-stack-based), not lexical (textual-nesting-based) -- a function defined in a sourced lib file still sees the caller's `local` variables when invoked from within that caller's own execution. A verbatim, byte-for-byte relocation is therefore both simpler AND strictly safer than a parameter-conversion rewrite (which itself risks introducing a subtle behavior change), and makes the required byte-identical --dry-run diff a structural guarantee rather than something to verify painstakingly.

approaches_tried.approach: Build the fixture-root PROJECT_ROOT inside a fresh /tmp mktemp -d tree with real (copied) specs/ and agent-system/ subdirectories
approaches_tried.reason: orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's collaborator scripts (orchestrate-triage-classify.sh, orchestrate-batch-admit.sh) independently resolve their own state-file path via PROJECT_ROOT, ignoring the --state-file argument I passed explicitly -- so a /tmp fixture with no real specs/ produced extra WARNING lines not present in the baseline. Fixed by symlinking the fixture's specs/ and agent-system/ subdirectories to the real repo's corresponding directories, so PROJECT_ROOT-relative lookups transparently resolve to the real data without ever touching the real .claude/ deployed tree.

approaches_tried.approach: Run run-all.sh --jobs auto once after the extraction and treat its result as final
approaches_tried.reason: First run surfaced 2 NEW failures (test-force-phases.sh, test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh) beyond the 3 EXPECTED + 1 foreign-typst baseline from Phase 3. Both were genuine regressions in THIS task's own test fixtures (not ambient flakiness): each suite builds an isolated .claude/scripts/lib/ fixture tree via its own hardcoded file list or glob from the (stale, undeployed) .claude/ tree, and neither included the newly-created territory-contention-lib.sh. Fixed both suites' fixture-setup code to also copy/resolve territory-contention-lib.sh from the source store, then re-ran to confirm return to the Phase-3 baseline (3 expected + 1 foreign, 0 new).

notes: wc -l: orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh 3026 -> 2749 (277 fewer lines, ~9.2% reduction); territory-contention-lib.sh is 330 lines (287 lines of relocated code/comments + a new 43-line extraction-method header).
